title: enrol-request

protocolVersion.description: The protocol version this message is written in

claimCode.description: The claim code an admin created in Hall, e.g. K7QM-4TZP (case, dashes and spaces are ignored)

publicKey.description: Ed25519 public key: the 32 raw bytes, base64url without padding (the JWK "x" value)

orquestraVersion.description: The Orquestra's software version (FARAD_VERSION), e.g. v1.4.0

apiVersion.description: The Orquestra's local API version, e.g. 1.1.0

imageDigest.description: The running image digest, sha256:<64 hex>

serial.description: The board's serial number, when it has one

model.description: The board, e.g. Raspberry Pi 5 Model B Rev 1.0

siteName.description: The site's name set in the Orquestra (Settings › Site)

device.description: What the device says about itself when it enrols

description: Enrolment: the device presents a claim code and the public key it generated. The request is signed with that key.
